Simple:
```js
export function slugify(title) {
  return title
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-');
}
```
.trim() before collapse handles leading/trailing whitespace. But need trim leading/trailing hyphens too — after trimming whitespace and collapsing, no leading/trailing hyphens remain. Fine. But safer: `.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')`. Keep simple; the doc says trim leading/trailing hyphens. I'll collapse then trim hyphens to be faithful.
